definitions.explanation: An exceptional, almost supernatural level of talent or the person possessing it. The character {鬼|おに} (demon, spirit) suggests talent so extreme it seems inhuman. Often used to praise artists, directors, musicians, and other creative figures.

examples.english: He is a genius of the film world.

examples.japanese: {鬼才|きさい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作品展|さくひんてん}。
examples.english: An exhibition by a painter called a genius.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{鬼才|きさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ほしいままにした⟦{音楽家|おんがくか}→音楽家：27511_ongakuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The musician who earned a reputation as a genius at a young age has released a new work.

notes:
Literally "demon talent" — the ⟦{鬼|おに}→鬼：02184_oni⟧ (demon/spirit) implies talent so extraordinary it borders on the supernatural.

USAGE:
{鬼才|きさい} is a strongly laudatory term, used mainly in media, criticism, and literary writing. It appears most often as an epithet preceding a person's name or title: {鬼才|きさい}・{黒澤明|くろさわあきら} (the genius Akira Kurosawa). It is more dramatic and literary than ⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧, carrying a nuance of dark brilliance or unconventional originality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鬼才|きさい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to be called a genius
- {鬼才|きさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧: possessor of extraordinary talent
- {鬼才|きさい}⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧: genius director
- {鬼才|きさい}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧: to display one's genius

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧: genius — the most common word for genius; neutral and broadly applicable, without the dramatic "demonic" nuance
- ⟦{秀才|しゅうさい}→秀才：18297_shuusai⟧: brilliant person — implies academic excellence and diligence more than raw creative power
- {異才|いさい}: exceptional talent — similar to {鬼才|きさい} but less dramatic; emphasizes being different rather than supernaturally gifted
